# Stephen Chinedu Anigbo, MBBS

> Stephen Chinedu Anigbo is a Nigerian-trained medical doctor, researcher, and AI systems evaluator working across clinical medicine, scientific research, artificial intelligence, scientific communication, SEO, and digital strategy. Website: https://stephenanigbo.com/ · Contact: hello@stephenanigbo.com

Name: Stephen Chinedu Anigbo (honorific suffix: MBBS)
Roles: Medical Doctor · Researcher · AI Systems Evaluator (Scientific Benchmarking)
Location: Nigeria (AI work is remote)
Motto: "Aut viam inveniam aut faciam" — I shall either find a way or make one.

## Key facts
- MBBS, University of Nigeria, Nsukka (2016–2023)
- Medical Intern, University of Uyo Teaching Hospital (Feb 2024 – Feb 2025): 6,000+ hours of supervised clinical training
- Medical Officer, Nigerian Air Force Medical Centre, Uyo (Sep 2025 – Aug 2026)
- AI Systems Evaluator (Scientific Benchmarking), confidential AI project under NDA, remote (Sep 2026 – present). Public description is limited to non-confidential responsibilities: scientific benchmarking, model evaluation, failure-mode analysis, reference-solution development, quality assurance.
- Research: COVID-19 vaccine uptake among doctors (2023); CKD progression and APOL1 nephropathy cohort (2021); smartphone use among university students (2019–2021)
- Writing: second place, 2015 Wole Soyinka International Cultural Exchange essay competition; essays on Substack
- Toolkit: SPSS, R, Python; SEO and digital publishing
